science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

active_location.macro_silhouette: Towering jagged spears of cooling black rock cutting through a violently active ferrofluid sea.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be climbed or used for cover against the shearing winds.
Can be harvested cautiously when the shear winds briefly part.
A dense patch of glowing spores that masks heat signatures.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: The harsh black angles of basalt contrasting with the rhythmic, jagged silver flashes of the ferrofluid sea.
sensory_palette.sound: The deafening howl of shear winds ripping across the magnetic waves.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: Biting cold wind mixed with the strange electric prickle of ozone on the skin.
sensory_palette.smell: Sharp metallic tang of raw lodestone and whipped salt.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A faint, gritty iron residue on the lips.

horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Survive the encroaching winter whilst rationing dwindling supplies.
horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Secure a safe path across the basalt formations.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Map the magnetic anomalies of the outer rim.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If Kaio fails, the ferrofluid surge knocks the supplies loose; if Ryn fails, the rations plummet into the sea.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio tossed the supplies to Ryn as the wind roared.

encounter_matrix.three_levels_of_why: Why are they here? To gather rare moss for rations. Why is it dangerous? Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea. Why does it matter? The colony will starve without fresh caloric inputs.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To crash and reshape the basalt pinnacles.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Surging violently in unpredictable magnetic waves.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: A sudden spike in magnetic shear destabilizes the handoff point.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The waves grow taller, threatening to wash over the outcropping.
